name: real_world_modi_pstack_adapter_v1_response_calibrated_20260721
description: Real-world Gaepo modi P-Stack config with local ramp-arrival forecasting, rough METANET parameter recalibration from 1800s full-run freeway segment states, wider VSL/ramp candidate search, and freeway-interface SC1 signal actuation enabled through control_mapping.json.
notes: v_free uses low-density freeway segment p95 speed around 121 km/h from full 1800s decision state JSONs.
freeway_capacity_veh_h uses observed segment flow envelope around 6900 veh/h on the 4-lane freeway links.
rho_crit is placed near the observed high-flow density envelope, roughly 28-31 veh/km/lane.
This is a first response-calibrated candidate; full METANET calibration still needs a forced-response grid with controlled VSL and metering perturbations.
